sloka: ततस्ते चुक्रुशुर्हृष्टा लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमाहवे ।। ६.५९.८३ ।।।।
transliteration: tataste cukruśurhṛṣṭā labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।nīlalāghavasambhrāntaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇamāhave ।। 6.59.83 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.
